summary: More than a quarter of movers gave a family reason: marriage, a split, a parent's care.
realLife: Family-related reasons made up 27.9 percent of moves in 2017.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, Overall Mover Rate Remains at an All-time Low (2017): https://www.census.gov/library/stories/2017/12/lower-moving-rate.html
inGame: needs: a family reason on the move record, from the partnerships and care records.

turns.what: A family reason keeps someone from moving: a parent who needs care stays.
turns.writesBack: no move; a care line on the card

turns.what: A move for family is also a move for a job.
turns.pulledBy: a spouse's job and a relative's offer
turns.writesBack: both facts set on the move record
